commands_used: answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka of the Toh-Reel-Ka in Helstrom. I took a Kothringi Keystone from the Pale Harvest wreck. The Collector (Ennodius Vanin) and the Unbound are hunting the Eye. 2. Go to Toklea and show the keystone to the elder of the Chime-Keepers in the Kothringi Greathouse; the marker is on Hums-the-Long-Note. 3. I can talk to Hums-the-Long-Note, find the elder, or look around. I see no other choice yet. 4. I do not know what the Eye is, or what the keystone does. The elder of the Chime-Keepers may tell me.

answer 1. Hums-the-Long-Note knows the keystone but wants payment: her family grave-stake from a chest in drowned Zul-Etha. 2. Go to Zul-Etha (south-east of Mir-Xal quay) and raise the stake from the Drowned Chest. 3. Fight the crocodiles and old bull from a roof or with arrows (my favoured way), calm them with Illusion, or swim under unseen. 4. I do not know where exactly Mir-Xal is or why she cannot just tell me; the marker should guide me.
take Carved Grave-Stake from Drowned Chest
